'''September 2001 Cincinnati tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in ACME, Cincinnati, Ohio on 15 September 2001. [[Tyler Martin]] won it. It is known from Alex George's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2964">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-15-cincinnati-oh-9-15-01-i-like-eggsd2964/ cincinnati-oh-9-15-01-i-like-eggs], DeckTech (Alex "george3785" George, 15 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-15-cincinnati-oh-9-15-01-i-like-eggsd2964/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 15 September 2001
* '''Site:''' ACME, Cincinnati, Ohio
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Tyler Martin]]
